title: A night at the opera
blurb: The old opera house in 前门 still puts on 京剧 every night.
lead: The opera house in 前门 is selling tickets.

steps.now: Buy a ticket from the opera house owner and watch a show (50 元).
steps.past: Watched a 京剧 show at the 前门 opera house.

title: Tea for the granny
blurb: A granny in 大栅栏 misses the tea 老刘 used to bring her.
lead: A granny in 大栅栏 remembers a friend from the teahouse.

steps.now: The granny of 大栅栏 misses 老刘’s tea. Buy tea leaves 茶叶 at the teahouse on 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: Bought tea leaves at 老刘's teahouse.

steps.now: Bring the tea to the granny in 大栅栏.

title: Roast duck
blurb: The roast-duck waiter on 前门 loves showing people the right way to wrap it.
lead: Something smells wonderful on 前门 street.

steps.now: The waiter outside the roast-duck shop on 前门 shows you how to wrap it — do what he says.
steps.past: Wrapped roast duck the proper way.

title: Opera faces
blurb: An opera actor explains what the colours of the painted faces mean.
lead: An actor at the 前门 opera house is painting his face.

steps.now: The actor at the 前门 theatre explains the painted faces — pick the right one.
steps.past: Learned the opera faces from the actor.

title: 《城南旧事》 — the camel bell
blurb: 英子, like the girl in 《城南旧事》, lost a small camel bell she loved.
lead: A girl on 前门 street is listening for something.

steps.now: 英子 on 前门 street lost a small yellow camel bell. Ask the old granny in 大栅栏 — old Beijing families kept camel bells. (The antique market at 潘家园 has them too, far to the south-east.)
steps.past: Found a little yellow camel bell at 潘家园.
Gave 英子 her camel bell.

title: 《西游记》 — the Monkey King
blurb: A boy dressed as the Monkey King plays at 72 changes on 前门 street.
lead: A boy with a golden stick jumps about on 前门 street.

steps.now: A boy dressed as 孙悟空 on 前门 street turns into things. Guess what from his words.
steps.past: Guessed every one of 孙悟空's changes.

title: 哪吒 or 孙悟空?
blurb: Two boys on 前门 street argue who is stronger, 哪吒 or 孙悟空.
lead: Two boys on 前门 street are arguing loudly.

steps.now: Two boys on 前门 street argue who is stronger. Settle it.
steps.past: Settled the argument between 哪吒 and 孙悟空.
